search.title: Your search
search.subline: Here you define what matters to you in a potential co-founder.
search.private: These settings are private. They shape what you are shown — they are not on your profile, and nobody sees them.
search.themesTitle: How should the person fit you?
search.themesIntro: Besides experience and availability, how you work can be decisive. You can choose the topics where similarity matters to you — and where you deliberately want someone with a different approach.
search.themesNote: Different does not automatically mean as opposite as possible. It is about whether you deliberately want another perspective or way of working.
search.importanceLabel: How important is that to you?

decision_weighing.title: Weighing decisions
decision_weighing.text: How thoroughly are options, pros and cons or assumptions examined?

experience_intuition.title: Experience & gut feeling
experience_intuition.text: How much weight do experience and first impressions carry in a decision?

experimentation.title: Trying things & learning
experimentation.text: How early is something tried out when information is still missing?

raising_objections.title: Raising objections
raising_objections.text: How quickly is an objection made visible rather than carried along?

voicing_disagreement.title: Voicing disagreement
voicing_disagreement.text: How clearly is disagreement named when it matters?

open_questions.title: Living with open questions
open_questions.text: How does someone deal with something staying undecided for a while?

search.saveFailed: That did not work just now. Your selection is still here. Please try again.
search.changeLater: You can change this at any time.
search.emptyTitle: You have not set any matching preferences yet.
search.emptyText: FIND can still show you profiles — just without saying which ways of working fit what you are looking for.
search.staleTitle: Your selection belongs to an older version of the working profile.
search.staleText: The questions have changed. Take a quick look and save again so it matches what is being asked.
search.needsProfileTitle: Your working profile is still missing.
search.needsProfileText: The topics come from the questions about how you work. Without your own answers there is nothing to compare.
